story: A five-man breakaway formed early, with Darren Rafferty posing a GC threat and forcing XDS Astana to control the gap. Movistar’s fierce pace on Cozzo Tunno dropped several sprinters and Maglia Rosa Silva. After a late attack from Jan Christen, who was caught by Sobrero, Jhonatan Narváez sprinted to victory ahead of Orluis Aular, while Giulio Ciccone claimed the Maglia Rosa through bonus seconds.
